title: $p^*$ preserves tensor products
statement:
For condensed abelian groups $F$ and $G$, the oplax tensor comparison
morphism $p^*(F\otimes G)\to p^*F\otimes p^*G$ of $p^*$ (for the oplax
structure of [lem-sfb-point-upper-star-unit] and the tensor products of
[sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]) is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Unfold pointUpperStar to the concrete sheaf pullback of [def-sfb-point-upper-star]. Finite-limit preservation [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-finite-limits] makes the site functor representably flat; its opposite comma categories are filtered and hence sifted. Tensoring abelian groups preserves their colimits. Continuity is [lem-sfb-profinite-to-proetale-continuous], and the existing Kan-extension and sheafification instances apply. The tensor clause of [lem-sfb-general-sheaf-pullback-monoidal-comparisons] therefore gives invertibility of the actual oplax tensor map in [lem-sfb-point-upper-star-unit], for all F,G.
